nodes.label: Master Entity Batch CRUD Pattern
nodes.rationale: Master entities expose batch Create, Update, Delete, and Toggle commands (max 100 items). Each handler iterates items, collects per-index failures without aborting the batch, persists successful changes via IUnitOfWork, and returns partial-success responses pairing successes with BatchItemFailure records.

nodes.label: Master Lookup Column Resolution Pattern
nodes.rationale: Lookup queries accept dynamic value/label column names plus optional field mappings. EntityColumnResolver validates snake_case scalar columns via reflection and resolves values at runtime. Validators enforce column validity, unique key names, max 20 extra fields, and forbid reserved keys 'value'/'label'.

nodes.label: Gridify List Filtering Pattern
nodes.rationale: List queries accept optional Filter and OrderBy strings with paging (Page, PageSize 1-100). Application layer passes criteria to repository; GridifyOrderByNormalizer converts order-by segments to PascalCase C# property names before Gridify applies filtering and sorting.

nodes.label: Screen Metadata Resolution
nodes.rationale: Resolves a menu code into a full screen metadata bundle: menu, entity definition, entity fields, grid columns, and form fields. Field names are normalized to camelCase for frontend consumption.

nodes.label: EF Core Repository Layer
nodes.rationale: Master-data and registry repositories use EF Core BillingDbContext with LINQ queries, soft-delete filters, and change tracking for CRUD operations.

nodes.label: Dapper SQL Repository Layer
nodes.rationale: Auth and endpoint-access repositories bypass EF Core and execute parameterized raw SQL via Dapper and IDbConnectionFactory for performance-critical lookups.

nodes.label: Gridify Master Listing
nodes.rationale: Driver, Truck, and NameBoard list endpoints share a Gridify-based filtering, ordering, and pagination pipeline with entity-specific mappers.

nodes.label: Result Railway Pattern
nodes.rationale: Application handlers return Result or Result<T> with typed Error instead of throwing; API controllers translate failures to ProblemDetails HTTP responses.

nodes.label: Endpoint Access Authorization
nodes.rationale: Each controller action declares an endpoint code via EndpointAccessAttribute; a global filter checks role-endpoint permissions against app_endpoint and app_role_endpoint tables.

nodes.label: Refresh Token Rotation
nodes.rationale: Refresh tokens are stored as SHA-256 hashes, looked up when active, revoked on rotation with replaced_by_id chain, and bulk-revoked on logout.

nodes.label: API Path Configuration Pattern
nodes.rationale: Controller segments in API_CONTROLLERS are composed into /api/{controller}/... paths via buildApiPath; endpoints groups mirror backend ASP.NET controllers (auth, access, masters, screens, health).

nodes.label: React Query Key Mirror Pattern
nodes.rationale: queryKeys namespaces (access, screens, name-boards, trucks, drivers, menus) parallel endpoints resource groups so TanStack Query cache keys stay aligned with REST paths.

nodes.label: Screen Slice Lazy Mount Pattern
nodes.rationale: Per-screen Redux reducers inject on first visit via ensureScreenSliceMounted/useScreenSlice and are removed on unmount; SCREEN_KEYS tie slice names to menu codes from MENU_CODES.

nodes.label: shadcn UI Primitives Pattern
nodes.rationale: UI primitives wrap Radix or native elements with cn() from lib/utils for Tailwind class merging; Sidebar composes Input, Sheet, Skeleton, and Tooltip for responsive layout.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture
nodes.rationale: Billing v3 API follows the sample/clean_architecture template: SharedKernel, Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Web.Api layers with tests. Controllers stay thin; business logic lives in Application handlers.

nodes.label: CQRS with MediatR
nodes.rationale: Commands and queries flow API → MediatR → validation → handler → repository. Screen metadata uses GetScreenByMenuCodeQuery; masters use batch command handlers per entity folder.

nodes.label: Persistence Split (EF vs Dapper)
nodes.rationale: Auth (app_user, refresh_token) uses Dapper for JWT refresh rotation. Registry, menus, role-menu, and master entities use EF Core with snake_case Npgsql naming.

nodes.label: Custom JWT Auth (No Keycloak)
nodes.rationale: Authentication is custom JWT + refresh tokens with BCrypt password hashing. No external identity provider (Keycloak) is used.

nodes.label: Auto-Apply Migrations in Development
nodes.rationale: Pending EF migrations apply once at startup via ApplyMigrations() in Program.cs during Development. Designer .cs files are required for each migration or EF won't discover it.

nodes.label: snake_case DB / camelCase API
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL app_entity_field.field_name uses snake_case. List DTOs and screen metadata fieldName use camelCase. FieldNameConverter.ToCamelCase runs in AppEntityScreenRepository after load. Frontend must not convert field names. Gridify orderBy from UI is camelCase; GridifyOrderByNormalizer converts to PascalCase for repositories.

nodes.label: No PostgreSQL CRUD Functions
nodes.rationale: v3 replaces billing_v2 SQL fn_* routines. All CRUD and business logic lives in C# Application handlers, not PostgreSQL stored functions.

nodes.label: Split Grid vs Form Metadata
nodes.rationale: UI layout is split: app_entity_screen_column for grid columns and app_entity_screen_field for form fields. Screens link menus to entity grid + form metadata.

nodes.label: Menus Before Screens Seed Order
nodes.rationale: Seed order is strict: (1) app_menu menus before app_entity_screen because screens reference menu_id, (2) entity registry, (3) screen columns/fields, (4) app_endpoint registry, (5) app_role_endpoint grants, (6) restart API for EndpointAccessCache refresh.

nodes.label: Optional Local Postgres
nodes.rationale: docker-compose includes optional local Postgres for clean-architecture template. Web.Api is NOT wired to it when using Neon. Integration tests use Testcontainers instead. Normal development does not require docker compose up postgres.

nodes.label: Per-Screen Dynamic Redux Slices
nodes.rationale: Auth stays mounted permanently. Each screen slice is injected on page mount via useScreenSlice and removed on unmount (state discarded). TanStack Query holds server/list data; screen slices hold UI-only state (filters, selection, draft form).

nodes.label: Hybrid Redux + Zustand DataTable State
nodes.rationale: Screen slice (Redux) holds table state: page, pageSize, sort, global filter, selectedIds. Zustand per DataTable instance holds columnVisibility, columnFilters, showColumnSearch. DataTableProvider syncs Redux value/onChange and runs list query + mutations.

nodes.label: column_width_percent Layout
nodes.rationale: Base grid width is 100. Actions column has its own percent (e.g. 12). Data budget = 100 - actionsPercent. If visible data column sum ≤ budget, split equally; if sum > budget, use configured percents and allow horizontal scroll via computeDataTableLayout().

nodes.label: Actions Column in Metadata
nodes.rationale: Actions column is seeded in app_entity_screen_column with column_component=actions, is_pinned=true, high display_order. Page provides renderActionsColumn callback. Excluded from column picker; sticky right when renderer provided.

nodes.label: is_enabled / is_active Not Grid Columns
nodes.rationale: is_enabled and is_active are seeded with is_visible=false. They drive enable/disable toggles in action buttons and inactive row styling, not grid column display. Excluded via isDisplayableGridColumn().

nodes.label: Metadata-Driven Grid Columns
nodes.rationale: Pages wait for metadata.status === succeeded before rendering DataTable. mapScreenColumnsToDataTableColumns(getPrimaryEntityColumns(metadata.entities)) produces columns prop. Full column structure renders before data loads; skeleton rows cover data fetch.

nodes.label: Batch POST API Pattern
nodes.rationale: Masters use GET for list/get and POST for create/update/delete/toggle with items arrays. Responses include created/updated/deletedIds and per-index failures for partial batch success.

nodes.label: Singular Menu Codes
nodes.rationale: Menu codes are singular: name_board, truck, driver. They map to SCREEN_KEYS and pages/masters routes. Migration script migrate_menu_codes_to_singular.sql exists for legacy plural values.
